name: seo-blog-engine
description: A reusable, project-agnostic ORM/SEO blog engine for Claude Code. The engine (skills) stays constant; each website supplies its own brand, voice, config, and secrets.

plugins.name: seo-blog-engine
plugins.description: Draft, fact-check, SEO-check, and publish long-form ORM/SEO blogs to any CMS (WordPress first). Reads per-project context from the working directory; secrets stay in a gitignored .env.
